name: clothing
description: People sell clothes and shoes they own, picked up in person or shipped.

description.description: The item and anything to know about it, such as the exact size on its label.

price.description: The price of the item, without shipping.

wearer.description: Who the item is made for: a unisex item is for women and men, and baby is under two.

kind.description: What the item is: a kind of clothes or of shoes; a jumper is a sweater.

size.description: The size of adult clothes, by letter.

waist.description: The waist size in inches, as the label carries it, such as 32; with none on the label, measured round the waistband.

height.description: The height of the child the clothes fit, in centimetres, such as 104, from a newborn up.

footLength.description: The length of the foot the shoes fit, heel to longest toe, in centimetres, such as 24.5, children's to adults'.

location.description: Where the item is; in a request, where the buyer is.

asDescribed.description: Whether the item was as the post said.
